In de functie van engineer beheer ligt je focus op het oplossen van eerste- en tweedelijns incidenten en service requests. Je reageert adequaat op signalen vanuit onze monitoringsystemen, waardoor je proactief verstoringen voorkomt. Je functioneert vooral zelfstandig en plant zelf de taken die zijn vastgelegd in beheer en productieplannen. Je deelt je kennis met collega’s en helpt ze bij het uitvoeren van hun taken. Daarnaast registreer en documenteer je jouw activiteiten. Je Werkzaamheden Optimale afhandeling en registratie van (standaard) changes en service requests Oplossen van incidenten die zijn doorgezet door je collega’s van de eerste lijn Up-to-date houden van systeemdocumentatie Indien nodig tickets openen bij leveranciers om specifieke productproblemen te verhelpen Aan de hand van ons eigen monitoringsysteem de klantomgevingen bewaken en actie te ondernemen bij problemen Automation: taken optimaliseren en automatiseren False positives in onze monitoring opsporen en verhelpen Het beheren van virtuele omgevingen, zoals VMware, Hyper-V alsook virtuele servers in de cloud zoals in Azure. Periodiek stand-by staan buiten kantoortijden In de functie van engineer beheer word je gestimuleerd na te denken over je toekomst binnen onze organisatie en de vaardigheden die bij die carrièrewensen passen. Door middel van ontwikkelgesprekken maken we duidelijke afspraken over trainingen, opleidingen of andere ondersteuning die je nodig hebt om je ambities waar te maken. Ook krijg je in deze rol de kans bij diverse klanten aan de slag te gaan als beheerengineer. Team.up Je maakt als engineer beheer deel uit van ons remote beheerteam. Ons team remote beheer bestaat uit twaalf enthousiaste collega’s, van schoolverlaters tot ervaren engineers. review_candidates.title: Specialist, Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: Position Overview The mission of the Office of Data and Technology is to support schools and the district as a whole to use technology and data effectively to accelerate student achievement. The Office includes the following teams: The Information Technology team provides DCPS students and staff in every school with the infrastructure, systems, and support to use technology effectively to accelerate student achievement. The Data team ensures stakeholders at all levels of the organization have access to accurate, timely, and relevant data, conducting analysis and research, and building school-based capacity to use data tools to inform planning and decision-making. The Enterprise Application team leads the district’s efforts to ensure all DCPS students and staff, in every school, have application technology and systems needed to be successful. The Information Technology team provides DCPS students and staff in every school with the infrastructure, systems, and support to use technology effectively to accelerate student achievement. The Specialist, Systems Administrator will play a significant role in the administration and end user support of the instructional and business-critical operational/productivity systems. Serving as an escalation point from the service desk, the Specialist, Systems Administrator, will apply their advanced skillset and troubleshooting experience to identify the root cause and resolve issues in a timely fashion. Proficiency in core business and educational platforms, including Microsoft Office 365, Entra ID and education technology, is critical to the success of this position. The Specialist, Systems Administrator is a technical support role that requires regular in-person presence to perform essential job functions, including maintaining IT infrastructure, supporting enterprise systems, responding to operational issues, and providing hands-on technical assistance. This position has been designated as Security Sensitive. Pursuant to section 410 of Chapter 4 of the D.C. Personnel Regulations; in addition to the general suitability screening, individuals applying for or occupying security sensitive positions are subject to the following checks and tests: Criminal background check; Sex Offender Registry check; Traffic record check (as applicable); Consumer credit check (as applicable); Reasonable suspicion drug and alcohol test; and Post-accident or incident drug and alcohol test. The Specialist, Systems Administrator will report to the Director, IT Infrastructure and Operations. Essential Duties and Responsibilities The below statements are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work being performed by this position. This is not a complete listing of all responsibilities, duties, and/or skills required. Other duties may be assigned. Provides level 2 in-person and virtual business and education platforms support to DCPS staff and students by serving as an escalation point from the service desk. Documents incidents, problems, and service requests through the district’s ITSM. Follows strict service level agreements to ensure timely service. Supports the configuration of business and education platforms to ensure requirements are implemented with fidelity. Performs ongoing maintenance and troubleshooting of instructional platforms and applications to ensure their ongoing availability, stability, and compliance with established standards and security requirements, including but not limited to setting up users, roles, security, and internal system notifications. Works closely with various senior-level system administrators and business application owners on SSO, data, and systems integrations. Develops secure automated solutions for administrative and domain management tasks. Maintains, administers, and supports Office 365, Entra, Teams, and Exchange. Assists in administering mission critical instructional platforms such as Clever, Canvas, LightSpeed, and Adobe. Assist in administering school operation and administrative applications. Interfaces with Microsoft and other solution providers for any tier 3 support requirements. Develops concise and accurate engineering and knowledgebase documentation, including design plans, implementation guides, knowledge guides, and standard operating procedures. Identifies risks and problems and conducts qualitative and quantitative analysis to generate and evaluate alternatives and to make recommendations. Works closely with the academic and education technology teams to gather requirements and implement solutions to meet desired outcomes. Follows organizational change management processes and standard operating procedures to plan for and implement continuous improvements of the environment. Qualifications Bachelor's degree and three to five years of related work experience, including a minimum of three years of enterprise level Azure/AD/Office 365 Administration experience. Master's degree preferred. Previous exposure to or experience in the education sector a plus. Microsoft Azure and Office 365 certifications. High degree of system-specific knowledge and a background in the various technologies and practices required by DCPS, including: Entra ID, VDI platform, Office 365 Suite, Canvas and Clever. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of PowerShell and the ability to create and maintain scripts for effective use with exchange/Office 365 and Azure environments. Experience with the integration of Office 365 with third party security and application tools. Strong communication skills and experience partnering with senior IT and program leadership. Must be able to express key ideas and obtain tangible feedback from cross-functional team members and stakeholders. Works well with clients and other vendors in achieving mission success and is committed to providing quality products and services. Obsessive attention to detail and accuracy of information. Must be available after hours and on weekends to respond to urgent requests and emergencies as needed. DCPS Values STUDENTS FIRST : We recognize students as whole children and put their needs first in everything we do. COURAGE : We have the audacity to learn from our successes and failures, to try new things, and to lead the nation as a proof point of PK-12 success. EQUITY : We work proactively to eliminate opportunity gaps by interrupting institutional bias and investing in effective strategies to ensure every student succeeds. EXCELLENCE : We work with integrity and hold ourselves accountable for exemplary outcomes, service, and interactions. TEAMWORK : We recognize that our greatest asset is our collective vision and ability to work collaboratively and authentically. JOY : We enjoy our collective work and will enthusiastically celebrate our success and each other. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from individuals with disabilities. Accommodation and/or application assistance is available upon request at all stages of the application and employment process. To request accommodation, please contact dcps.eeo-ada@k12.dc.gov.

review_candidates.title: Sr Platform Engineer, Data
review_candidates.description: Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble! Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country. Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference! O.N.E Purpose: Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations. Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation. Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results. The Opportunity: Job Summary By embodying our core purpose of customer obsession, new ideas, and driving innovation, you will help ensure that every touchpoint is meaningful and contributes to our mission of redefining the possible in healthcare. As a Senior Platform Engineer, you are a hands-on technical engineer who sits at the intersection of data engineering, cloud platform, and networking — building the infrastructure and pipelines that make Ensemble's data platform reliable, secure, and scalable. You will design and implement Azure-based platform solutions, author data pipelines, harden network architecture, and apply solid software engineering discipline across everything you ship. This is primarily a delivery role. You will spend the majority of your time writing code, configuring infrastructure, reviewing pull requests, and solving hard operational problems — not managing people or setting org-wide strategy. You bring strong opinions about platform reliability, cloud cost, and network security, and you translate those opinions into running systems. We are open to strong cloud/platform engineers who want to go deep on data, and to strong data engineers who have grown into platform and networking responsibility. What matters is that you have done hard, hands-on work at the intersection of these disciplines — you understand both why a pipeline fails and why a Private Endpoint DNS record is wrong, and you are comfortable owning both. JOB COMPETENCIES Platform & Cloud Engineering — Designs, builds, and operates Azure-based platform infrastructure — compute, storage, networking, identity, and security — with a bias toward infrastructure as code, repeatability, and operational simplicity; balances speed of delivery with platform reliability and cost efficiency. Data Engineering Depth — Delivers scalable, well-tested data pipelines and transformations on Databricks and Azure Data Factory; applies sound data modeling, performance tuning, and data quality discipline as standard practice rather than afterthoughts. Network & Security Awareness — Understands Azure networking constructs — VNets, subnets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, DNS, and ExpressRoute/VPN — and applies them correctly in platform design; proactively identifies and closes network attack surface without creating unnecessary friction for engineering teams. Software Engineering Craft — Writes clean, testable, maintainable code; participates actively in code and design reviews; treats CI/CD and automated testing as the default way of working; holds a high bar for version control hygiene and deployment safety. Operational Ownership — Takes end-to-end accountability for the platform components and pipelines in scope — from initial design through production monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement; does not hand off and walk away. Technical Communication — Communicates clearly with both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders; can explain complex networking or data platform trade-offs to a product manager or a VP without losing the audience or oversimplifying the substance. Continuous Learning & AI Fluency — Stays current with the Azure, Databricks, and data engineering ecosystem; consistently applies generative AI tools to accelerate engineering work, improve code quality, and troubleshoot complex systems. Essential Job Functions Customer Obsession, New Ideas, Striving for Excellence Consistently deliver high-quality platform and data solutions that improve the reliability, speed, and accuracy of data reaching internal and external stakeholders. Apply generative AI tools in day-to-day engineering work to accelerate development, improve code quality, troubleshoot complex systems, and design scalable solutions. Data Pipeline & Platform Engineering Design, build, test, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve scalable data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Apache Spark, and Python. Implement Delta Lake patterns on Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) including table design, schema evolution, Z-ordering, VACUUM, and partition strategies. Build and maintain event-driven integrations using Azure Service Bus, Event Hub, and Azure Functions to support real-time and near-real-time data flows. Implement data quality monitoring frameworks — row counts, schema validation, null checks, freshness SLAs — as first-class pipeline components. Develop reusable pipeline templates and platform abstractions that accelerate delivery across the data engineering team. Translate product and business requirements into incremental, testable technical deliverables with clear acceptance criteria. Azure Cloud Platform & Infrastructure Provision and manage Azure infrastructure using infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates), treating all platform configuration as version-controlled code. Design and operate Azure-native services including Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Microsoft Fabric (or Synapse), Azure Key Vault, and Azure Monitor. Manage identity and access controls using Azure Active Directory, Managed Identities, RBAC, and Unity Catalog — applying least-privilege principles across all platform components. Implement platform-level observability: pipeline SLAs, workload performance dashboards, alerting, and cost tracking via Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Databricks system tables. Contribute to FinOps practices by monitoring compute costs, right-sizing clusters, configuring auto-termination policies, and flagging cost anomalies. Support containerized workloads running on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) where data platform components require container-based deployment patterns. Networking & Security Design and implement secure Azure networking architectures for data platform workloads — VNets, subnets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, and service endpoints — eliminating unnecessary public internet exposure for PaaS services. Configure, troubleshoot, and document Private Link connectivity across Azure PaaS services (ADLS, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Event Hub, Databricks); diagnose DNS resolution issues and routing problems end-to-end. Apply encryption-in-transit and encryption-at-rest standards; maintain TLS configurations, key rotation policies, and secret management practices in line with security baselines; participate in security reviews and threat modeling for new platform components. Partner with Cloud and Infrastructure teams on hub-and-spoke or landing zone network topologies; configure and validate firewall rules and IP allowlisting in a way that balances security posture with engineering team productivity. CI/CD, DevOps & Engineering Standards Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps that automate testing, validation, and deployment of data pipelines, notebooks, and infrastructure code. Follow and actively contribute to branching strategies, pull request standards, and code review practices; flag gaps or inconsistencies in existing workflows and propose improvements. Write unit, integration, and data quality tests as standard deliverables — not optional additions after the feature is shipped. Contribute to engineering standards and pattern libraries, ensuring consistency across pipelines and reducing onboarding friction for new team members. Software Engineering & Architecture Write well-structured, maintainable Python and SQL code; apply design patterns, modular decomposition, and API design principles appropriate to the problem at hand. Participate in design sessions and architecture discussions, contributing hands-on perspective on what is feasible and what the operational implications of design choices will be. Conduct thorough code and design reviews that raise the engineering bar across the team. Identify and address technical debt within owned platform components in a planned, incremental way. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship Partner with data engineering, analytics, data science, and cloud/infrastructure peers to deliver integrated platform solutions. Provide mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance. Communicate platform capabilities, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to product and business stakeholders. Employment Qualifications Required Skills & Experience 6+ years of hands-on engineering experience, with meaningful time spent across data engineering and cloud platform or infrastructure domains. 3+ years working with Microsoft Azure services in a production environment (ADF, ADLS Gen2, Databricks, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Hub, Azure Monitor). 2+ years of hands-on Azure networking experience: VNets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Private DNS, service endpoints, and firewall configurations. 2+ years developing with Apache Spark and Databricks, including Delta Lake table design, schema evolution, and performance optimization. 4+ years of production SQL development — complex transformations, query tuning, indexing, and data modeling at enterprise scale. Strong Python development skills applied to data engineering, pipeline orchestration, or platform tooling. Demonstrated experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred; Bicep or ARM acceptable). Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps; familiarity with trunk-based development and pull request workflows. Experience with event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus, Event Hub, or equivalent messaging platforms. Working knowledge of Azure identity and access management: Azure AD, Managed Identities, RBAC, and Key Vault. Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals: automated testing, code reviews, telemetry, iterative delivery, and DevOps. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with data platform security and governance: Unity Catalog, column-level security, data masking, and audit logging. Background in software engineering (APIs, microservices, or distributed systems) that informs platform design and operationalization decisions. Experience with polyglot storage architectures: relational, columnar (Parquet/Delta), key-value, or graph systems. Exposure to healthcare datasets; familiarity with HL7 or EDI standards is a plus. Experience supporting AI/ML or advanced analytics workloads — feature stores, training data pipelines, or model serving infrastructure. Familiarity with AKS, container networking, and Kubernetes-based workload deployment patterns. Azure certifications relevant to the role (e.g., AZ-305, DP-203, AZ-700) are a plus, but not a substitute for demonstrated hands-on experience. Familiarity with FinOps practices, Databricks cost management, and Azure cost optimization tooling. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. WORKING CONDITIONS Remote-friendly with periodic travel for team meetings, onsite collaboration, or client engagements. General office environment or work from home. May require occasional off-hours support for platform incidents or scheduled maintenance windows. This position pays between $101,600 – $152,400 based on experience Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
